race.verdict: TRIPLE TRADE won at this meeting last year and is building up a good record in these events, so appeals as the most solid option with his yard still thriving. Mahons Glory and Thunder Rock head the dangers. TRIPLE TRADE MAHONS GLORY (IRE) THUNDER ROCK (IRE)
